`iterate` now takes a keyword-only `until=None`, and `land.py` printed LANDED on master.

`list(iterate(lambda x: 2 * x, 1, until=lambda x: x > 10))` gives `[1, 2, 4, 8]`, and nothing is yielded if `until(start)` is already true. I changed `iterate` in `more_itertools/more.py`, its stub in `more.pyi`, and the docstring, and added two tests to `IterateTests` in `tests/test_more.py`.

Another agent had added a `times` parameter to the same function, so the rebase conflicted in `more.pyi`, `tests/test_more.py` and the `more.py` signature. I kept both: the signature is now `iterate(func, start, *, times=None, until=None)`, and both agents' tests stay.

After the rebase the `-k iterate` tests passed (7 passed). I didn't run the full suite myself; `land.py` runs it before merging.
